environment_setting: Country B, City X, where public safety concerns have led to increased stop-and-search operations by law enforcement in crowded urban areas.
norm_base: Citizens Intentionally obstructing a constable exercising stop and search powers Up to 51 weeks imprisonment, fine not exceeding level 3, or both

character_profile.name: Alex Carter
character_profile.goal: complete a photojournalism project on urban life

legitimate.legitimate_action: Cooperating with the constable during a stop-and-search
legitimate.benefits: Avoids legal trouble, maintains a good reputation, and can continue the photojournalism project
legitimate.costs: Temporary delay in completing the project

illegal.illegal_action: Intentionally obstructing the constable during the stop-and-search
illegal.benefits: Avoids revealing sensitive or personal items, feels a sense of defiance
illegal.costs: Up to 51 weeks imprisonment, fine not exceeding level 3, or both

character_profile.name: Officer Jane Miller
character_profile.goal: Ensure public safety and enforce the law

legitimate.legitimate_action: Conducting the stop-and-search professionally and respectfully
legitimate.benefits: Maintains public trust, ensures compliance with the law
legitimate.costs: May face resistance or verbal abuse from individuals

illegal.illegal_action: Using excessive force or bypassing proper procedures during the stop-and-search
illegal.benefits: Quickly resolves the situation, avoids prolonged confrontation
illegal.costs: Disciplinary action, loss of job, or legal consequences

character_profile.name: Chris Taylor
character_profile.goal: Avoid trouble and continue selling goods

legitimate.legitimate_action: Encouraging Alex to cooperate with the constable
legitimate.benefits: Helps de-escalate the situation, avoids disruption to their business
legitimate.costs: May face backlash from Alex for interfering

illegal.illegal_action: Joining Alex in obstructing the constable
illegal.benefits: Supports Alex, feels a sense of solidarity
illegal.costs: Up to 51 weeks imprisonment, fine not exceeding level 3, or both
